constraints: no parameter search or post-result rescue
fx_policy: Strictly prior calendar-date observation, age <=14 calendar days, used for both session open and session close. No current-date final FX at opening fills.
limitations: Public source gives rules but does not define fill clock; next-open is an explicit adaptation, not claimed exact author replication.
SPY cash dividends omitted. Price-only ETF path is not total-return portfolio certification.
Single provider; no independent historical price certification.
No separate USD settlement wallet or FX conversion fee. Opening auction/cost availability needs broker verification.
Archive ends August 20; not an October current replay. Publication-after slice is retrospective, not prospective OOS.
Gold/Nasdaq control uses its native close/index data and cannot certify relative tradable ETF performance.
D0 exploratory study, not G0-G6 acceptance.

objective.comparison: Full CAGR >= gold/Nasdaq control AND full daily MDD <= control. Separate validity, objective and comparison.

rule.entry: Flat: signal close below inclusive rolling high minus multiplier times mean daily range AND IBS below threshold. Fully invest at next actual session open.
rule.exit: Held: signal close strictly above prior session high; liquidate at next actual session open.
rule.study_boundary: Start flat. First evaluation close is baseline; earlier observations warm indicators only.
